title: Temporary State Control of Energy Market to Keep Electricity Prices Stable for Consumers and Businesses
what_it_is: Temporary State Control of Energy Market to Keep Electricity Prices Stable for Consumers and Businesses

sections.label: Global gas prices and Singapore
sections.summary: Global gas prices rose on high demand and tight supply, and Singapore relies on imported natural gas for around 95% of its electricity.

sentences.speaker: The Second Minister for Trade and Industry (Dr Tan See Leng) (for the Minister for Trade and Industry)
sentences.text: Global gas prices have increased significantly, due to high demand and tight gas supply.

sentences.speaker: The Second Minister for Trade and Industry (Dr Tan See Leng) (for the Minister for Trade and Industry)
sentences.text: The global energy markets are expected to remain volatile and elevated with the protracted conflict in Ukraine, and this is also coupled with the seasonal increase in energy demand from countries in Europe and Asia, especially during the coming winter.

sentences.speaker: The Second Minister for Trade and Industry (Dr Tan See Leng) (for the Minister for Trade and Industry)
sentences.text: With Singapore relying on imported natural gas to generate around 95% of its electricity, our domestic energy prices would not be immune from the volatility in global energy markets.

sections.label: EMA energy supply measures
sections.summary: EMA set up the SLF, required gencos to stockpile fuel and introduced TRECS, ensuring uninterrupted supply and stabilising USEP without state control.

sentences.speaker: The Second Minister for Trade and Industry (Dr Tan See Leng) (for the Minister for Trade and Industry)
sentences.text: Specifically, EMA established a Standby LNG Facility, called the SLF, and also required generation companies (gencos) to bolster their own stockpile of fuel.

sentences.speaker: The Second Minister for Trade and Industry (Dr Tan See Leng) (for the Minister for Trade and Industry)
sentences.text: EMA also introduced the Temporary Electricity Contracting Support Scheme (TRECS) to help large consumers secure retail contracts.

sentences.speaker: The Second Minister for Trade and Industry (Dr Tan See Leng) (for the Minister for Trade and Industry)
sentences.text: These measures have helped to ensure uninterrupted energy supply and stabilised the Uniform Singapore Energy Price (USEP), without the need to bring the electricity market under state control within the short- to medium- term.

sections.label: Electricity import plans
sections.summary: Besides the LTMS pilot, EMA has an ongoing Request for Proposal to import up to four gigawatts of electricity by 2035.

sentences.speaker: Dr Tan See Leng
sentences.text: Other than the Lao PDR-Thailand-Malaysia-Singapore Power Integration Project, which is a pilot that we started, also known as the LTMS, EMA has an ongoing Request for Proposal (RFP), to import up to four gigawatts of electricity by 2035.

sections.label: Low-carbon energy alternatives
sections.summary: Singapore is developing low-carbon alternatives such as hydrogen, exploring carbon capture utilisation and storage, and geothermal energy potential.

sentences.speaker: Dr Tan See Leng
sentences.text: Third, we are developing low-carbon alternatives, such as hydrogen, and we are also exploring the use of carbon capture utilisation and storage; and at the same time, also exploring Singapore's potential for geothermal energy.
